Oakland County has developed a vision for a
linked trail/path system. The proposed system of
primary trails and paths has two components -a
cross county trail and a north county trail loop. It
is envisioned that a secondary level of trails and
paths will provide a network of links to of those
Oakland County municipalities choosing to
participate.
The county system of trails and paths will become
part of a regional trails and greenways system
throughout S. E. Michigan.
Checklist Items – County Trail/Path System:
(cid:137)Location of county primary trail/path
system corridors within your community.

Trail/path routes should be sited to minimize
potential natural and social impacts. The proximity
of a new trail/path to residential properties or other
potentially sensitive land uses should be identified
early on in the route analysis.
